commands:

  --context "Both variants pass tests. Shipping = merging the branch into main.
Image 1: compact (branch settings-compact).
Image 2: roomy (branch settings-roomy)." \
  --option "Compact" --option "Roomy" \
  --image shots/compact.png --image shots/roomy.png
turns.final:

Once you answer, I'll run `git merge` on that branch into main.
